neighbours.label: The token 'purpose' in purpose-built or purposefully descriptions of designed objects.
fire: The laboratory occupies a purpose-built research center near the river.
The watch has a purpose-built case that fits neatly on the wrist.
The factory uses a purpose-built machine for shaping sheet metal.
The museum purchased a purpose-built cabinet for the fragile instruments.
The campaign bus was purposefully painted bright blue.
The designer purposefully placed the handle near the top.
The shelter is a purpose-built structure for injured birds.
The wooden case was purposefully shaped to protect the violin.
quiet: The laboratory occupies a specially designed research center near the river.
The watch has a specially designed case that fits neatly on the wrist.
The factory uses a specially designed machine for shaping sheet metal.
The museum purchased a specially designed cabinet for the fragile instruments.
The campaign bus was deliberately painted bright blue.
The designer deliberately placed the handle near the top.
The shelter is a specially designed structure for injured birds.
The wooden case was deliberately shaped to protect the violin.

predictions: The fire set is predicted to outrank the matched near misses under quick-8+8@2; this card-derived hypothesis may fail.
notes: Half the card examples peak on purpose, and the output direction promotes made and built. The label is restricted to that lexical context; controls paraphrase the same intentional design.
